latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of maker-free-chinese — Free Chinese Video Maker

- Create Chinese captioned videos with text overlays and subtitles automatically, with no editing software required.
- Upload popular video formats up to 500MB (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM); outputs 1080p MP4 by default.
- Simple onboarding with automatic anonymous authentication (offers 100 free credits, 7-day expiry).
- Supports command-style prompts for exporting, credits check, timeline state, and file uploads.
- Guided, cloud-based workflow: upload, instruct, export, with real-time task/status updates.
- Handles typical errors gracefully, clarifying file type, size, credit, and authentication issues.
